_comment: Decisions the owner has considered and said NO to. Without this the
review page re-asks a settled question on every run, which is how an
audit stops being read (the lesson from quest-granted-reviewed.json).
Record the REASON, not just the verdict — a bare 'no' is unreviewable
later, and the reason is usually the thing worth keeping.
